reconcile.note: Gill and Jamieson-Fausset-Brown read Bethsaida as Peter and Andrew's native town and Capernaum as the home where they had since settled and where Jesus later found them.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible lists Mark's Capernaum household against John's naming of Bethsaida as the city of Andrew and Peter as a straightforward contradiction of place.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
sides.verseText: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

sides.snippet: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter.
sides.verseText: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter.
